# Oryx Centre for Strategic Futures

> Independent research initiative working on AI governance, geopolitics, emerging technologies and strategic foresight, from the Global South. Founded 2 October 2026, based in Noida, India. Research you can audit: every material claim traceable to its evidence, with consequential judgements kept with an accountable human.

## Pages

- [Home](https://oryxai.in/): Research you can audit, for a complex world. The Centre's founding framework, engagement steps, and founder introductions.
- [Oryx AI](https://oryxai.in/oryx-ai.html): Auditable research from Oryx AI. How an engagement works, what you receive, and the guided demo.
- [Sample report](https://oryxai.in/oryx-ai-sample-report.html): A published sample of an auditable research report on AI citations. A sample, not a client report.
- [How to check AI-generated citations in your own paper](https://oryxai.in/how-to-check-ai-citations.html): A four-verdict method for checking AI-generated citations, in about ten minutes per batch.
- [How to check an AI vendor's claims before you sign](https://oryxai.in/how-to-check-ai-vendor-claims.html): A six-step check to run on a vendor's claims, using the vendor's own materials, before you sign.
- [AI governance evidence checklist: prove every claim](https://oryxai.in/ai-governance-evidence-checklist.html): A practical checklist for governing AI adoption: inventory the claims, check each source resolves and supports the claim, name the human who accepts the risk, and keep the record.
- [Human review gate AI: what a human must check](https://oryxai.in/human-review-gate-ai.html): A human review gate is a named person checking an AI output before it is used — not a disclaimer. Learn where gates belong, what the reviewer checks, and what to record.
- [AI vendor due diligence checklist: evidence first](https://oryxai.in/ai-vendor-due-diligence-checklist.html): Before you sign with an AI vendor, check the evidence behind the claims, the data handling, and the exit terms. A practical due-diligence checklist for buyers, with red flags and a scoring method.
- [AI pilot evaluation checklist](https://oryxai.in/ai-pilot-evaluation-checklist.html): A checklist for evaluating an AI pilot before committing.
- [Broken links in AI citations](https://oryxai.in/broken-links-ai-citations.html): Findings on broken links in AI-generated citations.
- [Auditable research report: AI-generated citations, 2023-2026](https://oryxai.in/auditable-research-report-ai-citations.html): Approved sample report from Oryx AI's local MVP test run on 1 Nov 2026. A sample, not a client delivery.
- [Verified beta report: LLMs in healthcare, 2023-2026](https://oryxai.in/oryx-ai-beta-report-31oct.html): Public-beta verification run, 31 Oct 2026 — 7 sources, 7/7 verified, human-reviewed before publication. A beta run, not a client delivery.
- [Evidence Audit and Vendor-Claim Verification (India)](https://oryxai.in/evidence-audit-india.html): Claim-by-claim audit of AI-generated reports and vendor claims packs for clients in India, payable only if the report passes criteria agreed in writing beforehand.
- [Evidence Audit and Vendor-Claim Verification (international)](https://oryxai.in/evidence-audit-abroad.html): The same audit service for clients outside India, on the same payable-only-if-it-passes terms.
- [Sales floor](https://oryxai.in/sales-floor.html): Roster of the Oryx AI sales-agent desks, drafting and monitoring only. No desk sends, signs, changes a price, spends, or makes a public claim on its own.
- [Privacy policy](https://oryxai.in/privacy-policy.html): What this site collects (nothing on its own), how email enquiries are handled, and how to opt out of outreach.
- [Terms of service](https://oryxai.in/terms.html): Terms for Oryx AI pilot engagements, including acceptance and pay-only-if-it-passes payment.
- [Refund policy](https://oryxai.in/refund-policy.html): No payment is taken before acceptance, so an unaccepted report has nothing to refund.

## Papers

- [From Answers to Auditable Intelligence (working paper v3.0)](https://oryxai.in/Oryx_Working_Paper_v3.pdf): A governance-first framework for agentic AI in strategic research and public policy, by Amartya Kumar and Riya Nalwa. Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23718472, CC BY 4.0.
- [Trust, But Verify (Paper 2 v2)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23731235): A claim-level citation audit of AI-generated strategic research briefs: 30 briefs, 194 citations — Verified 50 (26%), Broken 95 (49%), Title mismatch 17 (9%), No URL 1, Unverifiable 31 (16%).
